issue.title: Request: Whitelist npub for publishing on relay.zapstore.dev
issue.body:
Request: Whitelist npub for publishing on relay.zapstore.dev
  Hi Zapstore team! I'd like to publish my Android app on Zapstore. I've already published the Nostr events to other relays, but relay.zapstore.dev rejects them with event pubkey is not allowed.
  App Details
  • Name: NeroHedge
  • Package: xyz.nerodolla.wallet
  • Category: Finance / Privacy
  • Description: Self-custodial Monero (XMR) wallet with automated FX hedging via perpetual futures
  • License: MIT
  • Website: https://app.nerohedge.app
  • Source: https://github.com/rpetermc/nerodolla
  • APK: https://nerohedge.app/nerohedge-release.apk
  Publishing Identity
  • npub: npub1eydmpxn40ruu9tjsy2n9ucdgv3g3yqmdhfm5ekdthvjfqjcpsdss26l3nr
  • pubkey (hex): c91bb09a7578f9c2ae5022a65e61a8645112036dba774cd9abbb24904b018361
  Verification
  • Identity proof (kind 30509): Already published and verifiable on relays — links APK signing certificate to the above Nostr pubkey
  • APK certificate hash: 99899c3c9d3d0123c7d3a908753eb302f4664cdf645962cdad407eab4ec68887
  • APK SHA256: a74a08af88848f2e888e513f31befd5ea58b9421ed8a9255b52bb803238e90ab

comment.body: Figured it out — zapstore.yaml needed to be committed to the repo root with the pubkey field. Auto-whitelisting kicked in once it was on GitHub. All events published successfully now, thanks!

issue.title: Zapstore crashes when trying to install White Noise
issue.body:
**Device:** Fairphone 6
**OS:** /e/OS
**Zapstore version:** 1.0.6+3006

**Description:**
Zapstore repeatedly crashes when attempting to install White Noise. No error message is shown. No VPN active at the time.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Open White Noise app page in Zapstore
2. Tap install
3. Zapstore crashes

**Expected:** App installs successfully
**Actual:** Zapstore crashes, no feedback

**Additional info:**
Successfully installed via direct APK download from GitHub releases.
App starts and runs correctly. Issue is specific to Zapstore installation.

comment.body:
**Update / Workaround found:**

After the issue occurred, I noticed that Zapstore was unable to install any other app as well – not just White Noise.

Uninstalling Zapstore and reinstalling it via Obtainium resolved the issue. White Noise and other apps can now be installed 
successfully via Zapstore.

This suggests the problem may be related to a corrupted Zapstore installation rather than a specific app issue.

Recurring monthly subscriptions via NWC
Localization
issue.body:
``` Zapstore currently has no localization implementation:                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - All strings are hardcoded in English - 248 Text widgets across 64 Dart files with ~58 unique strings                                                                                                         
  - intl package is included but only used for DateFormat, not actual i18n                                                                                                                                       
  - No translation files (.arb, .json, etc.)                                                                                                                                                                     
  - No locale switching mechanism                                                                                                                                                                                
  - Two inconsistent date/time formatters with hardcoded English ("Just now", "m ago", "years ago")                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  The codebase is ready for localization but would need:                                                                                                                                                         
  1. Flutter's gen_l10n setup with ARB files                                                                                                                                                                     
  2. String extraction from all widgets                                                                                                                                                                          
  3. Unified date/time formatting with locale awareness                  
 
```

issue.title: Add NIP-55 support
issue.body:
This PR implements proper NIP-55 Android signer support using a new Dart package, nip55_signer. The nip55_signer package can detect all NIP-55 signer apps installed on the device, not just Amber. When signing in, it automatically uses the signer if only one is installed, or prompts the user to choose if multiple are available. The user's signer preference is remembered across app restarts, so they won't need to select again. Session data is stored securely using the device's native secure storage rather than as Nostr events.

issue.title: Add opt-in crash reporting with NIP-17 encrypted delivery
issue.body:
## Summary

Implements a privacy-focused crash reporting system using NIP-17 gift-wrapped encrypted messages.

- Crashes are cached locally and only sent after user consent
- Reports are encrypted using NIP-44 and wrapped with NIP-59 gift wrap protocol
- Ephemeral keys hide sender identity on relays
- NIP-40 expiration tags ensure auto-deletion after 30 days

## Changes

1. **Crash caching service** - Local file-based crash storage with rotation (max 3 reports)
2. **NIP-17 gift wrap service** - Privacy-preserving encrypted message delivery
3. **Consent UI** - Dialog prompts user on startup if crashes are cached
4. **Debug test button** - Test crash button in Profile (debug builds only)

## Architecture

```
Crash → Cache locally → App restart → Consent dialog → User approves → NIP-17 encrypted DM
```

## Test plan

- [x] Trigger test crash in debug mode via Profile > About > Test Crash
- [x] Restart app, verify consent dialog appears
- [x] Send report, verify received in 0xchat
- [x] Test "Keep for Later" preserves cached crash
- [x] Test "Discard" removes cached crash

### Comments

1. DM receive pubkey is hardcoded to a test pubkey I made for this PR.


Closes #268
